    Journal Articles

    Dimensionality-driven electronic and excitonic properties of long-range ordered porous carbon (LOPC): A first-principles study

    Published in Computational Condensed Matter, 2026

    This study investigates the structural, electronic, optical, and excitonic properties of long-range ordered porous carbon (LOPC) in 1D, 2D, and 3D architectures using DFT and many-body perturbation theory.

    Recommended citation: M. de Aquino Campos, H. X. Rodrigues, R. Besse, C. M. O. Bastos, A. C. Dias, A. M. A. Silva, and L. A. Ribeiro Júnior, "Dimensionality-driven electronic and excitonic properties of long-range ordered porous carbon (LOPC): A first-principles study," Comput. Condens. Matter 46, e01208 (2026).
    Download Paper

    Structural effects on mechanical and optoelectronic properties of S-doped graphyne

    Published in Physical Review B, 2026

    This work explores the structural, mechanical, electronic, and optoelectronic properties of sulfur-doped graphyne (S-GY) using first-principles calculations.

    Recommended citation: B. D. Aparicio-Huacarpuma, C. E. P. Villegas, G. M. C. Meira, C. M. O. Bastos, A. C. F. Seridonio, A. C. Dias, L. A. Ribeiro, Jr., and E. Marinho, Jr., "Structural effects on mechanical and optoelectronic properties of S-doped graphyne," Phys. Rev. B 113, 035416 (2026).
    Download Paper

    Electronic structure and light-harvesting efficiency of Janus XSO (X = Sn, Ge) monolayers

    Published in Physica E: Low-dimensional Systems and Nanostructures, 2025

    This study investigates the electronic, optical, and photovoltaic properties of two-dimensional Janus XSO (X = Sn, Ge) monolayers using first-principles calculations.

    Recommended citation: B. D. Aparicio-Huacarpuma, M. Irfan, C. A. V. Huayhua, F. L. L. de Mendonça, C. M. O. Bastos, A. C. Dias, and L. A. Ribeiro, Jr., "Electronic structure and light-harvesting efficiency of Janus XSO (X = Sn, Ge) monolayers," Physica E Low-Dimens. Syst. Nanostruct. 177, 116453 (2026).
    Download Paper

    First-Principles Statistical Investigation of Thermodynamic Behavior with Excitonic Effects in $Mo_{1-x}W_{x}Se_{2}$ Alloys through a Data-Driven Workflow Approach

    Published in Journal of Materials Chemistry A, 2025

    We investigate thermodynamic stability of the $Mo_{1-x}W_{x}Se_{2}$ alloy at the atomistic level and introduce an innovative cost-effective protocol for predicting and characterizing its optoelectronic properties, explicitly incorporating excitonic effects.

    Recommended citation: C. M. D. O. Bastos, A. Cavalheiro Dias, A. C. Ferreira de Brito, I. Barcelos, A. L. da Rosa, D. N. Silveira, M. J. Piotrowski, W. Wenzel, C. R. C. Régo and D. Guedes-Sobrinho, J. Mater. Chem. A, 2025, DOI: 10.1039/D5TA02721G.

    Entangled Interlocked Diamond-like (Diamondiynes) Lattices

    Published in ACS Omega, 2025

    Diamondiynes, a new class of diamond-like carbon allotropes composed of carbon with sp/sp³ hybridized carbon networks, exhibit unique structural motifs that have not been previously reported in carbon materials.

    Recommended citation: Bastos, C. M. D. O., dos Santos, E. J. A., Alves, R. A. F., Dias, A. C., Junior, L. A. R., & Galvão, D. S. (2025). Entangled Interlocked Diamond-like (Diamondiynes) Lattices. ACS Omega, 10, 46065-46070.

    Toward High-Efficiency Solar Cells: Insights into AsNCa3 Antiperovskite as an Active Layer

    Published in The Journal of Physical Chemistry C, 2025

    Advances in photovoltaic technology are a viable route for contributing to cleaner and more sustainable energy solutions, placing perovskite-based materials among the best candidates for solar energy conversion. However, some challenges must be addressed to enhance their performance and stability.

    Recommended citation: Muhammad Irfan, et al. (2025). "Toward High-Efficiency Solar Cells: Insights into AsNCa3 Antiperovskite as an Active Layer." The Journal of Physical Chemistry C. https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jpcc.5c05620.

    Theoretical Prediction of 2D Y₂CTI (T = Br, Cl, F, H) Janus MXene Monolayers for Photovoltaic Applications

    Published in ACS Omega, 2025

    Two-dimensional Janus monolayers have garnered attention as promising materials for photovoltaic applications due to their distinctive structural, electronic, and optical properties. In this work, we investigate the solar harvesting efficiency of Janus $Y_{2}CTI$ (T = Br, Cl, F, H) MXene monolayers.

    Recommended citation: Bill D. Aparicio-Huacarpuma, et al. (2025). "Theoretical Prediction of 2D Y₂CTI (T = Br, Cl, F, H) Janus MXene Monolayers for Photovoltaic Applications." ACS Omega. 10, 45621-45632.

    $BA_{2}SnI_{4}$ as a Promising 2D Ruddlesden-Popper Perovskite for Optoelectronic Applications

    Published in The Journal of Physical Chemistry C, 2025

    Lead-free two-dimensional (2D) hybrid metal halide perovskites (MHPs) emerge as promising eco-friendly alternatives to lead-based counterparts, offering excellent thermodynamic stability and environmental compatibility despite lower solar harvesting efficiency.

    Recommended citation: J. F. Dalmedico, et al. (2025). "$BA_{2}SnI_{4}$ as a Promising 2D Ruddlesden-Popper Perovskite for Optoelectronic Applications." The Journal of Physical Chemistry C. 129, 9646-9655.

    Understanding stability and reactivity of transition metal single-atoms on graphene

    Published in Scientific Reports, 2025

    Recently, single-atom catalysts (SACs) based on transition metals (TMs) have been identified as highly active catalysts with excellent atomic efficiency, reduced consumption of expensive materials, well-defined active centers, and tunable activity and selectivity.

    Recommended citation: Morais, W. O., Felix, J. P. C., da Silva, G. R., Bastos, C. M. O., Dias, A. C., Flores, E. M., ... & Piotrowski, M. J. (2025). Understanding stability and reactivity of transition metal single-atoms on graphene. Scientific Reports, 15(1), 15496.

    Comprehensive analysis of 1T’ $CrS_{2}$ monolayer: Excitonic, optical, electronic, and structural stability

    Published in Materials Today Communications, 2025

    In this study, we conducted a comprehensive analysis of the excitonic, optical, electronic, and structural stability properties of the 1T’ $CrS_{2}$ monolayer. Phonon dispersion analysis confirms its dynamical stability, suggesting feasibility for experimental synthesis.

    Recommended citation: Celso Alves do Nascimento Júnior, et al. (2025). "Comprehensive analysis of 1T' $CrS_{2}$ monolayer: Excitonic, optical, electronic, and structural stability." Materials Today Communications. 46, 112304.

    Digital workflow optimization of van der Waals methods for improved halide perovskite solar materials

    Published in Digital Discovery, 2025

    Hybrid organic-inorganic metal halide perovskites are low-cost and highly efficient materials used in solar cell devices. However, the intricacies of perovskites that merge organic cations with inorganic frameworks necessitate further elucidation, particularly from the long-range van der Waals perspective.

    Recommended citation: Celso R. C. Rêgo, et al. (2025). "Digital workflow optimization of van der Waals methods for improved halide perovskite solar materials." Digital Discovery. DOI: 10.1039/d4dd00312h.

    Workflow-driven catalytic modulation from single-atom catalysts to Au-alloy clusters on graphene

    Published in Scientific Reports, 2025

    Gold-based (Au) nanostructures are efficient catalysts for CO oxidation, hydrogen evolution (HER), and oxygen evolution (OER) reactions, but stabilizing them on graphene (Gr) is challenging due to weak affinity. This study investigates forming metal alloys to enhance stability and catalytic performance of Au-based nanocatalysts.

    Recommended citation: Gabriel Reynald Da Silva, et al. (2025). "Workflow-driven catalytic modulation from single-atom catalysts to Au-alloy clusters on graphene." Scientific Reports. 15(1939).

    Excitonic properties and solar harvesting performance of $Cs_{2}ZnY_{2}X_{2}$ as quasi-2D mixed-halide perovskites

    Published in Journal of Alloys and Compounds, 2024

    Due to their low toxicity and high-temperature stability, lead-free quasi-2D metal halide perovskites (MHPs) are promising materials for optoelectronic applications.

    Recommended citation: Danilo Neves Silveira, et al. (2024). "Excitonic properties and solar harvesting performance of $Cs_{2}ZnY_{2}X_{2}$ as quasi-2D mixed-halide perovskites." Journal of Alloys and Compounds. 1007(176434).

    Can 2D Carbon Allotropes Be Used as Photovoltaic Absorbers in Solar Harvesting Devices?

    Published in ACS Applied Energy Materials, 2024

    This study used several computational methods, including density functional theory, density functional tight binding, and molecular dynamics simulations, to explore the solar energy conversion capabilities of 30 different 2D carbon-based allotropes.

    Recommended citation: Alexandre Cavalheiro Dias, et al. (2024). "Can 2D Carbon Allotropes Be Used as Photovoltaic Absorbers in Solar Harvesting Devices?." ACS Applied Energy Materials. 7, 8572-8582.

    Thermodynamic modeling and electronic properties of $CsPb_{1-x}Sn_{x}I_{3}$ as a polymorphic alloy

    Published in Journal of Alloys and Compounds, 2024

    We performed first-principles calculations combined with a statistical approach based on the generalized quasichemical approximation (GQCA) to study the polymorphic features of the $CsPb_{1-x}Sn_{x}I_{3}$ alloy. Our analysis explored the impact of these polymorphic features on electronic properties, statistical attributes, and thermodynamic stability.

    Recommended citation: Luis Octavio de Araujo, et al. (2024). "Thermodynamic modeling and electronic properties of $CsPb_{1-x}Sn_{x}I_{3}$ as a polymorphic alloy." Journal of Alloys and Compounds. 992, 174485.

    Ab initio investigation of structural stability and exfoliation energies in transition metal dichalcogenides based on Ti-, V-, and Mo-group elements

    Published in Physical Review Materials, 2019

    In this work, we report an ab initio investigation based on density functional theory of the structural, energetic, and electronic properties of 2D layered chalcogenides compounds.

    Recommended citation: Carlos M. O. Bastos, Rafael Besse, Juarez L. F. Da Silva, and Guilherme M. Sipahi. (2019). "Ab initio investigation of structural stability and exfoliation energies in transition metal dichalcogenides based on Ti-, V-, and Mo-group elements." Physical Review Materials. 3(044002).

    Size-Induced Phase Evolution of $MoSe_{2}$ Nanoflakes Revealed by Density Functional Theory

    Published in The Journal of Physical Chemistry C, 2018

    We report a density functional theory investigation of the size effect on the relative phase stability of stoichiometric $(MoSe_{2})_{n}$ nanoflakes with a parallelogram shape.

    Recommended citation: Rafael Besse, et al. (2018). "Size-Induced Phase Evolution of $MoSe_{2}$ Nanoflakes Revealed by Density Functional Theory." The Journal of Physical Chemistry C. 122, 20483-20488.

    A comprehensive study of g-factors, elastic, structural and electronic properties of III-V semiconductors using hybrid-density functional theory

    Published in Journal of Applied Physics, 2018

    The limitations of the theoretical approaches to yield accurate structural and electronic properties on an equal footing, is due to the unphysical self-interaction problem that mainly affects the band gap and spin-orbit splitting (SOC) in semiconductors.

    Recommended citation: Carlos M. O. Bastos, Fernando P. Sabino, Guilherme M. Sipahi, and Juarez L. F. Da Silva. (2018). "A comprehensive study of g-factors, elastic, structural and electronic properties of III-V semiconductors using hybrid-density functional theory." Journal of Applied Physics. 123(065702).

    Stability and accuracy control of k·p parameters

    Published in Semiconductor Science and Technology, 2016

    The k·p method is a successful approach to obtain band structure, optical and transport properties of semiconductors and it depends on external parameters that are obtained either from experiments, tight binding or ab initio calculations. Despite the widespread use of the k·p method, a systematic analysis of the stability and the accuracy of its parameters is not usual in the literature.

    Recommended citation: Carlos M O Bastos, et al. (2016). "Stability and accuracy control of k·p parameters." Semiconductor Science and Technology. 31(10), 105002.

    Realistic multiband k·p approach from ab initio and spin-orbit coupling effects of InAs and InP in wurtzite phase

    Published in Physical Review B, 2016

    In this study we calculate the ab initio band structure of bulk InAs and InP in the wurtzite phase and develop an 8x8 k·p Hamiltonian to describe the energy bands around the Γ point.

    Recommended citation: Paulo E. Faria Junior, et al. (2016). "Realistic multiband k·p approach from ab initio and spin-orbit coupling effects of InAs and InP in wurtzite phase." Physical Review B. 93(235204).

    Electrical and Optical Properties of Conductive and Transparent ITO@PMMA Nanocomposites

    Published in The Journal of Physical Chemistry C, 2012

    In this work, nanocomposite films of indium tin oxide (ITO) nanowires in a PMMA matrix were obtained by tape casting. The electrical, optical and morphological properties of films were studied as a function of the amount of wires inserted in the composite, and it was used 1, 2, 5, and 10 wt %.

    Recommended citation: Arlindo, E. P. S., Lucindo, J. A., Bastos, C. M. O., Emmel, P. D., & Orlandi, M. O. (2012). Electrical and Optical Properties of Conductive and Transparent ITO@PMMA Nanocomposites. The Journal of Physical Chemistry C, 116(22), 12946-12952.
